1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
386 of 2022, under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Mahanagar, District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 26.12.2022 against eleven named accused persons, including the applicant and two unknown persons alleging that applicant had made an offer to get the informant employed in return of payment of Rs. 8,00,000/-.
It is stated that in March 2019, co-accused Vikas Singh had demanded Rs. 3,00,000/- and the informant had Neeraj Pandey @ Neeraj Kumar Pandey vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

1 paid the amount to the aforesaid co-accused.
The F.I.R states that the applicant was also involved in commission of the offence.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
5. The criminal history of the applicant has been explained in Para 29 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application.
As per which he is involved in two other cases and in one of which the applicant has already been granted bail.

6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
7.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the F.I.R prima facie indicates that the informant himself was trying to commit an offence by securing an employment by payment of bribe, therefore, without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
